title: Unique Light Indian Beef Kidney Paratha
description: A briny and light Indian dish featuring beef kidney, this paratha is a crowd-pleaser and lacto-vegetarian-friendly. It is made with render-fat for added flavor.
instructions: Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat and saute the cumin seeds and curry leaves until fragrant.
Add the sliced beef kidney to the pan and cook until it is browned and cooked through.
Add the garam masala, salt, and rendered fat to the pan and stir to combine.
In a large bowl, combine the flour, yogurt, and water to make a dough.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it is smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 4-6 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle and place a spoonful of the beef kidney mixture in the center.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a paratha and seal the edges.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and cook the parathas for 2-3 minutes on each side until they are golden brown.
Serve the parathas hot with a side of yogurt or chutney.
